description: Token usage and cost per coding agent (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex). Note that the two cost figures are not comparable as a single number: OpenCode reports actual charged cost, while the Claude Code and Codex figures are API-equivalent estimates (a subscription has $0 marginal cost per request).

days.description: Look back this many days, counted from local midnight. Omit for all time.

includeSubagents.description: Include subagent turns. Default true: they are real spend.

models.description: Restrict to these model ids, as recorded (see model_usage).

offset.description: Rows to skip; pass `nextOffset` from the previous result.

projectPaths.description: Restrict to these projects: absolute working directories, matched exactly (see project_usage). A path matching nothing is reported, not answered as empty.

sort.description: Descending order. Reported and estimated cost are never summed, so there is no plain "cost": pick the basis you mean.

today.description: Restrict to today, in local time.

name: client_usage
title: Usage by client
